title: Maintaining and defending the training project
goal: Defend an independent configuration or extension, fix a transfer defect and prove recovery.
prerequisites: onec.p11; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Model, code and tests bind exact versions.
Actual input/output and exact own source identified; unperformed stages marked NOT RUN.
Accepted original preserved; rejection and its limits explained.
sections: A learner chooses service, warehouse, HR documents or synthetic finance. Requirements define model, operations, reports, invariants and admission. Use no real data or proprietary configurations. Study maintenance through an original training application and synthetic cases.

Open Nexus programming1C → Final assessment. Three theory variants, four practices and one of three projects have separate criteria. Read the selected variant before changing the infobase; retain attempt IDs/history. The application-course final does not substitute for programming.

Declare templates, permitted ideas, own changes and assistance. Review ties explanation to actual code, tests and results. Local reports are editable and cannot establish authorship. NativePASSconfirms named assertions, not professional status or an official certificate.

The Training service desk project connects model, write/rejection, posting/reposting, query/report and recovery. Choose a bounded discriminating change such as fixing an empty-customer loss or duplicate movements. Keep reproduction, own correction, both sources and the distinguishing test.

For example, reposting doubles a total or aJOINloses a request-free customer. Reproduce, form a hypothesis and write a discriminating test first. Fix a new copy and repeat baseline cases. Transfer work must not overwrite an accepted submission or erase attempts.

In5–7 minutes show actual references/numbers, code location, architectural reasons and an independent control change in another copy. Explain one rejection and restoration. Another person’s screenshot or an autogenerated protocol proves no authorship; disclose Akronikl/other help honestly.
A defense ends with a reproducible package

Submit requirements, diagram, sourceSHA, dataset, positive/negative tests, performance conditions and recovery. Identify environment limits and untested areas. Pdoes not substitute forAor vice versa; a copy may share the domain model but meets independent criteria and records its own outcome.

Submit requirements, sources, versions/SHA, synthetic input or creation steps, tests, limits and rollback. Redistribute no platform installer or third-party configuration. Local self-reported progress is not certification or server code grading. Keep accepted and control copies separate.
